fixed_in_phase_c.description: 30-s hookTimeout cascade across 14+ test files in api-server test suite: guardian-tool-mesh-persistence (12 failures), vessels-bol-persistence (2), atlas-execution-persistence (3), atlas-run-persistence (1), and several 'skipped' files with hookTimeout. All fail at exactly 30s — matching DB_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS.
fixed_in_phase_c.root_cause: CONFIRMED: Vitest 4 reuses worker subprocesses across test files (forks pool mode). Each test file AND each vi.resetModules() call creates a new @szl-holdings/db Pool. With DB_POOL_MIN=1 (default), each pool eagerly holds 1 idle connection. With DB_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS=60s (default), those connections stay open 60s after the test file finishes. After 30-40 test files, the total connection count across all worker-held pools exceeds Postgres max_connections (112). Subsequent pool.connect() calls retry for exactly connectionTimeoutMillis=30s, manifesting as hookTimeout failures. Secondary effect: when a test times out (describe-level 30s), in-flight supertest requests hold pool connections, creating soft-deadlocks that compound the exhaustion.
fixed_in_phase_c.fix: Added four pool overrides to src/__tests__/helpers/test-env-bootstrap.ts (the vitest setupFiles entry that runs before every test module): DB_POOL_MIN=0 (no eager connections), DB_POOL_MAX=10 (bounded concurrency per pool), DB_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS=8000 (8s idle release vs 60s), DB_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS=5000 (fail-fast if pool is full — breaks deadlocks in 5s instead of 30s). Uses ??= so explicitly-supplied env values are never overridden.
evidence: DB connection count dropped from 34+ to 4-13 after applying fix (monitored live during test run)
All three fix dimensions confirmed: min=0 eliminates eager connections, idle=8s releases stale connections quickly, connect_timeout=5s breaks deadlock cascade
vitest.config.ts fileParallelism=false was a prerequisite applied earlier to limit concurrent file execution
